<section class='av_textblock_section av-1gc5n2-f2286dda9dddaa528cb7c2f75874655c ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><h2 style="text-align: center;">Egypt&#8217;s first Watersport Lifestyle Hotel</h2>
<h5 style="text-align: center;">Because life&#8217;s better in flip flops!</h5>
</div></section>
<div class='hr av-554le-68e9424a7a5ab13e47afdf7a7e6bfe69 hr-invisible avia-builder-el-3 el_after_av_textblock el_before_av_one_fifth '><span class='hr-inner '><span class="hr-inner-style"></span></span></div>
<div class='flex_column av-1et7h6-65a1c24c75b572109747da660225d340 av_one_fifth avia-builder-el-4 el_after_av_hr el_before_av_three_fifth first flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding ' ></div>
<div class='flex_column av-1e6gne-a57bfe2c0223a83679fe96fc711f855a av_three_fifth avia-builder-el-5 el_after_av_one_fifth el_before_av_one_fifth flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding ' ><section class='av_textblock_section av-4z5be-7ee4b222c7c0dcd5f66ced11aeeb6192 ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><p><img decoding="async" class="aligncenter wp-image-3917 size-full" src="https://thebreakers.b-cdn.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Hotel.png" alt="" width="60" height="60" /></p>
</div></section>
<section class='av_textblock_section av-1d33li-435a18a255820eedfc0d672096489798 ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><p class="" style="text-align: center;" data-start="660" data-end="1151">The love for the sea connects us all at The Breakers. Wake up and dive straight into the crystal-clear water—just step off the 420-meter jetty into a mesmerizing underwater world. After a delicious breakfast, head to the KiteHouse to harness the power of the wind while kitesurfing or wing foiling. End the day with a relaxing yoga session before unwinding with a refreshing cocktail at your favorite spot, watching the breathtaking sunset.</p>
<p class="" style="text-align: center;" data-start="1153" data-end="1220">Sounds like the perfect lifestyle?<br data-start="1187" data-end="1190" /><strong data-start="1190" data-end="1218">Welcome to The Breakers!</strong></p>
</div></section></div>

<div class='flex_column av-1ba2xm-ad6d17ecce06230d06c92ccff2c3d7fa av_two_fifth avia-builder-el-10 el_before_av_three_fifth avia-builder-el-first first flex_column_div av-zero-column-padding ' ><section class='av_textblock_section av-1aixji-12292c590f7f0ec4d4c3a15ba0cb585a ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><h3 style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-size: 28px;">The Breakers</span><br />
<img decoding="async" class="nohover alignnone" src="https://thebreakers.b-cdn.net/wp-content/themes/enfold-child/images/sep.png" alt="Seperator" /></h3>
<p class="" data-start="774" data-end="1043">Arrive, unwind, and feel at home – at The Breakers, we make sure your holiday is truly unforgettable. No constraints, just modern hospitality and a concept tailored for kitesurfers, divers, and free-spirited travelers.</p>
<p class="" data-start="1045" data-end="1282">Whether you dive from sunrise to sunset, ride the waves while kitesurfing or wing foiling, stay active, or simply relax – here, your passion comes first! Surrounded by breathtaking nature, you’ll experience true freedom by the Red Sea.</p>
<p class="" data-start="1284" data-end="1389">No surprise that over 60% of our guests return regularly – some have stayed with us more than 30 times!</p>

<section class='av_textblock_section av-n48fe-1f6eb67f0bda7e281847b82b48970d57 ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><h3 style="text-align: center;">Romantic Dinner<br />

<img decoding="async" class="nohover alignnone" src="https://thebreakers.b-cdn.net/wp-content/themes/enfold-child/images/sep.png" alt="Seperator" /></h3>
<p class="" data-start="840" data-end="1094">Start your day in total relaxation: Enjoy a long breakfast on the terrace with a stunning sea view. Then, unwind with a cappuccino in one of our cozy chillout areas or soak up the sun on a beach lounger.</p>
<p class="" data-start="1096" data-end="1424">The Breakers is not just a haven for watersports enthusiasts – it’s also the perfect escape for those seeking relaxation! If you&#8217;re in the mood for some activity, join a yoga session, hit the fully equipped gym, or swim a few laps in the pool. And afterward? Treat yourself to ultimate relaxation with a soothing Thai massage.</p>
<p class="" data-start="1426" data-end="1537">End your day with cocktails, laid-back lounge music, and delicious food – and tomorrow, new adventures await!</p>

<section class='av_textblock_section av-dv1wm-cb61bbf781262731ac6af1771f56696c ' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><h3 style="text-align: center;">Massage<br />
